ball.note: Closed r-ball: [set x] at radius 0, then the previous ball plus all neighbours of its vertices; contains its centre at every radius and never leaves the centre's component (in an edgeless host every ball is its centre). Equal to rel_ball (--) r x; differs from the truncated graph_dist sublevel set once r >= #|G| on a disconnected graph.

set_ball.note: Union of the closed r-balls around the supplied seeds: empty for no seeds (and in K_0), the seed set itself at radius 0, ball r x for a singleton, additive over unions and monotone in the radius and the seeds.
